posts.title: Ellon Musk's Market Net Worth Versus Fair Value Net Worth
posts.description: Most of Ellon Musk's net worth consists of shares of radically overvalued companies. SpaceX, despite its technical and network accomplishments, has zero profits to date. posts.title: African Subsea Cable Update: Equiano, 2Africa, and Mombasa/Oman Daraja Project
posts.description: 1. There is an Equiano capacity glut. However, it will be brief (1 or 2 years) because Google is keeping 50% of Equiano's spare capacity for its own use over the cable's life span. posts.title: Hauwei Convicted In US Criminal Investigation: Trade Secret Theft, Money Laundering, & Working With Sanctioned Entities
posts.description: A Federal jury in Brooklyn found Hauwei guilty on ten counts of breaking US laws including money laundering, working with Iran's Revolutionary Guard, stealing trade secrets from Western technology firms, and lying to banks.
